Typically, individuals referred to Time To Care will present with Mental Health needs, Learning Disability, Autism, or other disabilities. Our Services Make A Referral Service Improvement Update Time to Care has made significant progress over the past six months as part of our ongoing service improvement journey. Following the recent CQC report, we accepted the findings in full and immediately began a focused improvement plan. Since then, we have worked closely with Northumberland County Council’s Safeguarding and Commissioning Teams and the CQC to strengthen our systems, improve accountability and ensure that the people we support remain at the centre of everything we do. We are pleased to share that, at the end of July 2026, Northumberland County Council confirmed Time to Care would be removed from safeguarding oversight and reinstated on the provider register. This reflects renewed confidence in our ability to provide safe, compassionate, and quality care.
